FOLLOWUP: Findings: 1 HIGH, 0 CRITICAL. HIGH: src-tauri/src/service/general_agent/workspace.rs:6-16 adds BUNDLED_CHAT_UI_PROVIDERS = [claude,codex,opencode,cursor] and default_chat_view_for_provider branches on provider-id literals instead of AgentProvider::supports_chat_ui()/registry capability. This violates the plugin/provider boundary and misclassifies non-bundled chat-UI-capable providers during General Agent first-run/workspace setup. Fix task: task_6vocq2.
